Map accompanies pamphlet entitled Vicksburg for the Tourist, rev. ed. ([Chicago] Passenger Department, Illinois Central System, 1925) 32 p. Copyright no. class F 49617, Apr. 11, 1925. Panoramic map in which "black lines indicate the Union trenches," "red lines indicate the Confederate line of defense," "white lines show the park roads," and "the stars mark general headquarters."
